note: REST Views Entity Revisions is a submodule of rest_views. It contributes one field formatter, 'entity_reference_revisions_export' (class EntityReferenceRevisionsExportFormatter extends the parent's EntityReferenceExportFormatter, field type entity_reference_revisions), for serializing ERR/Paragraphs references as nested structures. It adds no views_data_alter (rest_views already provides the field_export serializable handler for ERR fields). The formatter only works with the field_export handler. Requires entity_reference_revisions + rest_views. No config/route/permissions/Drush/plugin types. Medium cases read the live plugin registry and a real view config; hard cases enable the submodule (verify the formatter is registered) and set the formatter on a real REST export view config (config-level, verified against views.view).

evals.prompt: With rest_views_revisions, how do I export a Paragraphs (entity reference revisions) field as nested JSON in a Views REST Export, and what is the formatter id?
evals.expected_output: Use the field's serializable (field_export) handler and set its formatter to entity_reference_revisions_export. It serializes the referenced revisioned entities (Paragraphs) as a nested structure.

evals.prompt: What field type does the rest_views_revisions export formatter apply to, and which parent formatter does it build on?
evals.expected_output: It applies to the entity_reference_revisions field type (Paragraphs) and extends the parent rest_views EntityReferenceExportFormatter (the entity_reference_export formatter).

evals.prompt: Which modules does the rest_views_revisions submodule require, and does it add its own serializable Views handler?
evals.expected_output: It requires entity_reference_revisions and rest_views. It does not add its own hook_views_data_alter handler; it only adds the entity_reference_revisions_export formatter, because rest_views already provides the field_export serializable handler for ERR fields.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the registered field formatters and give the id of the export formatter that the rest_views_revisions module provides.
evals.expected_output: The rest_views_revisions module provides the field formatter entity_reference_revisions_export (provider rest_views_revisions).

evals.prompt: This site has a REST Export view rvr_known that exports a field using a rest_views_revisions formatter. Inspect the live view config and state which formatter (type) that field uses.
evals.expected_output: The rvr_known view's field uses plugin_id field_export with type entity_reference_revisions_export.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, make the entity-reference-revisions (Paragraphs) export field formatter available for Views REST Export by enabling the appropriate rest_views submodule. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The rest_views_revisions module is enabled (e.g. drush en rest_views_revisions), so the field formatter entity_reference_revisions_export is registered.

evals.prompt: The REST Export view rvr_task on this site has a serializable field that currently uses a plain formatter. Using rest_views_revisions, set that field's formatter to the entity reference revisions export formatter and save it to the live view.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.rvr_task the field keeps plugin_id field_export and its type (formatter) is set to entity_reference_revisions_export.
